terms.label: Debt to Total Capitalization Ratio

evidence.quote:
"Debt to Total Capitalization Ratio": as of any date of determination for the Borrower and the Restricted Subsidiaries, the ratio of (x)
Consolidated Total Debt to (y) the greater of (i) total capitalization calculated in accordance with GAAP and (ii) total capitalization calculated based on then-current stock trading price of the Borrower.

terms.note: denominator is the greater of GAAP total capitalization and market-price-based total capitalization (not a defined term)

terms.label: Consolidated Total Debt
children_labels: third party debt for borrowed money
obligations in respect of Financing Leases
Preferred Stock of its Restricted Subsidiaries

evidence.quote: "Consolidated Total Debt": as to any Person at any date of determination, an amount equal to the sum of (1) the aggregate principal amount of all third party debt for borrowed money

evidence_net_cash.quote: provided that "Consolidated Total Debt" shall be calculated (i) net of all unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents of such Person and its Restricted Subsidiaries at such date of determination

terms.note: unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents is subtracted (net debt)

terms.label: Consolidated First Lien Debt Ratio

evidence.quote: "Consolidated First Lien Debt Ratio": the ratio, as of any date of determination, of (a) Consolidated First Lien Debt as of the last day of the Test Period then most recently ended on or prior to such date of determination to (b) Consolidated EBITDA for the Test Period then most recently ended on or prior to such date of determination

terms.note: through the A&R Eighth Amendment the denominator was Annualized EBITDA (most recent quarter x 4)

terms.label: Annualized EBITDA

evidence.quote: "Annualized EBITDA": on any date of determination, Consolidated EBITDA for the most recently ended quarterly Test Period multiplied by four.

terms.note: historical denominator of the Consolidated First Lien Debt Ratio (2021 to 2024); removed by the time of the conformed-through-Amendment-9 copy

evidence.quote: "Consolidated First Lien Debt": as to any Person at any date of determination, the aggregate principal amount of Consolidated Total Debt of such Person outstanding on such date (a) that constitutes Obligations or Secured Notes Obligations or (b) that is secured by a Lien on the Collateral that does not rank junior to the Liens on the Collateral securing the Obligations

"Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio": as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) Consolidated EBITDA for the Test Period then most recently ended on or prior to such date of determination to (b) Fixed Charges for the Test Period then most recently ended on or prior to such date of determination

"Fixed Charges": as to the Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries at any date of determination, on a consolidated basis, for any period, the sum of (without duplication):
(1)Consolidated Interest Expense for such period;

terms.label: Consolidated Interest Expense

evidence.quote: "Consolidated Interest Expense": cash interest expense (including that attributable to Financing Leases), net of cash interest income of the Borrower and the Restricted Subsidiaries

terms.note: cash interest expense net of cash interest income, with exclusions (a)-(n); not decomposed

amendments_considered.what_changed: Fourth Amendment (Feb 7, 2023), marked conformed copy; Section 6.10 unchanged (DTC 0.70; CFLDR 5.00/4.00).
Fifth Amendment (Sep 15, 2023): commitment upsize; no Section 6.10 change found.
Sixth Amendment (Dec 18, 2023): commitment upsize; no Section 6.10 change found.
Seventh Amendment (May 3, 2024): commitment upsize; no Section 6.10 change found.

A&R Eighth Amendment (Sep 30, 2024), marked copy: DTC test excluded for Sep 30, 2024 and (if Covenant Holiday Trigger Event) Dec 31, 2024 / Mar 31, 2025; adds Minimum Liquidity ($100M quarterly from Dec 31, 2024; $50M monthly from Oct 31, 2024).

Conformed copy through Ninth Amendment (Nov 6, 2024; the Ninth Amendment itself was not found as a separate exhibit): DTC covenant removed; CFLDR re-based to TTM Consolidated EBITDA with new schedule from Mar 31, 2025 (8.75x stepping to 6.75x); new Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio (0.80x Q1 2025, 1.00x thereafter); Test Period redefined as four fiscal quarters.
Tenth Amendment (Nov 22, 2024): no Section 6.10 change found in the text.
A&R Eleventh Amendment (Mar 3, 2025): not separately analyzed; conformed-through-12 copy reflects its net effect.
Twelfth Amendment (May 12, 2025), per conformed-through-12 copy: CFLDR and FCCR not tested for Jun 30, 2025 (CFLDR clause (ii) Reserved); FCCR 1.00x from Sep 30, 2025.

Thirteenth (Nov 20, 2025) and Fourteenth (Dec 17, 2025) Amendments, per conformed-through-14 copy: CFLDR and FCCR also not tested for Sep 30, 2025; FCCR 1.00x from Dec 31, 2025; quarterly liquidity not tested for Dec 31, 2025.
Forbearance Agreement (Jan 20, 2026); restructuring context (RSA 8-K filed Mar 17, 2026). Not analyzed for covenant level changes.

draft_notes: Agreement chosen: NFE Revolving Credit Agreement dated April 15, 2021 (MUFG now agent), the main corporate RCF. NFE also has a Term Loan A, Term Loan B, an uncommitted letter-of-credit facility and project-level facilities, which were not labeled.

History is heavy and partly reconstructed from conformed copies (through Amendments 9, 12, 14). The Ninth Amendment, which removed the Debt to Total Capitalization covenant and reset the CFLDR, was not found as a standalone exhibit.

DTC effective_to = 2024-06-30 (last date it applied unconditionally). The A&R Eighth Amendment excluded Sep 30, 2024 subject to a Covenant Holiday Trigger Event, and the covenant is gone from the conformed-through-9 copy.
CFLDR 4.00x effective_to = 2024-09-30 is uncertain: the conformed-through-9 schedule starts at Mar 31, 2025 and is silent on Dec 31, 2024. Verify whether Dec 31, 2024 was tested.

CFLDR is springing (Revolving Facility Usage >= 50%). Through 2024 its denominator was Annualized EBITDA (latest quarter x 4, so effectively quarterly). From the 2025 conformed copies it is TTM Consolidated EBITDA. The label uses the current definition (ttm); the 5.00/4.00 entries were measured on the annualized basis.
Superseded before testing: CFLDR 7.25x for Jun 30, 2025 and 6.75x for Sep 30, 2025, and FCCR 1.00x for Jun/Sep 2025. These were replaced by 'not tested' and are omitted from the schedule.
FCCR breach condition is 'less than or equal to' the level (not strictly less than).
Two min_liquidity entries: $100M at fiscal quarter ends (Dec 31, 2025 not tested) and $50M at calendar month ends. The monthly test does not fit the quarterly schema; extra key 'frequency' added.
DTC kind = max_leverage and denominator 'total capitalization' (lowercase, not a defined term) are judgment calls.
Consolidated EBITDA children are paraphrased clause labels; Consolidated Net Income (long definition) not decomposed.
effective_to convention: last test date the level applies to.
